name: F-16
_about: An F-16 style HUD filling the visible window (x 120..680, y 100..380) in HUD green, one effect layer (shared/widgets/f16): the airspeed tape on the left is the car's speed (0..260 km/h or 0..160 mph, its box the speed in digits), the altitude tape on the right the rpm / 10 (0..700, its box likewise), the pitch ladder and the horizon line between them, the flight path vector, the bank angle scale under it, and the heading tape at the top once the car gives a heading. Until the car's own pitch, roll and heading are read (car/attitude_probe.js), the pitch and roll come from the g. Everything stays above BMW's speed and limit sign (x 150..355, y 314..378). During route guidance or driver assistance it draws nothing, so BMW's HUD shows.
